Senior journalist Suresh Kochattil explains the Congress leadership crisis in Telangana and Kerala, highlighting internal power struggles, growing dissatisfaction among Congress MLAs, corruption allegations and leadership challenges facing Revanth Reddy and VD Satheesan.

Why are Congress leaders expressing dissatisfaction with their own governments? What is behind the controversy over constituency funds, commission allegations and nominated posts? Can the Congress high command resolve these internal differences?

In this exclusive political analysis, Suresh Kochattil discusses the similarities between Telangana and Kerala Congress politics, internal factionalism, KC Venugopal's role, financial challenges, leadership disputes and the potential impact on the upcoming GHMC elections.

Watch the full interview to understand the political developments within Congress and the challenges facing its leadership in South India.
